title: Xiaomi to Invest RMB 16 Billion in AI This Year: CFO Says Steady Rollout, MiMo Usage and AI Revenue Continue to Grow
excerpt: RMB 16 billion is being poured into AI, and the books have not yet reached the harvest period, but management says the money is being spent steadily. According
content_html:
RMB 16 billion is being poured into AI, and the books have not yet reached the harvest period, but management says the money is being spent steadily. According to People's Finance News, Xiaomi Group CFO Alain Lam said at the earnings call last night that Xiaomi is very determined in its AI investment and will invest RMB 16 billion in AI this year. It is currently landing steadily along the plan, and the growth generated by the investment is visible: API calls for the MiMo large model and AI-related revenue are both continuing to increase.

Money goes into the foundation, and into the ecosystem

Alain Lam said Xiaomi's AI business is still in a period of large-scale investment: it continues to invest in foundation model R&D while accelerating the rollout of AI across its "Human-Car-Home" full ecosystem. On the product side, the Xiaomi 18 Fold already features the MiMo on-device large model, and "Super Xiao Ai 2.0" in HyperOS 4 also deeply integrates the MiMo large model—from flagship foldables to system-level voice assistants, large models are no longer just cloud services, but have been packed into daily life on phones and speakers.

The anxiety is real, and so is the opportunity

This talk of "steady implementation" echoes what Lei Jun said a few days earlier. On November 17, Lei Jun attended the APEC CEO Summit; in an interview on the 18th, he admitted that as the AI wave sweeps across industries, he can feel some anxiety as an AI practitioner. But he also believes that fields such as "AI + phones" and "AI + embodied intelligent robots" offer enormous possibilities, and that a disruptive moment will arrive in the next three to four years. With real money—RMB 16 billion—on one side and a "three to four years" timeline on the other, Xiaomi is placing its bet on the same direction.
